scripts.typecheck: bunx --bun typescript@5.9.3 --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v 'node_modules/' | grep -q 'error TS' && exit 1 || exit 0
scripts.review: lsof -ti:8001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run build-review && bun run serve-review
scripts.review-local: lsof -ti:8001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run build-review && bun run src/review-dashboard/server.ts --local
scripts.dev-stats: bun run build-stats-data && cd src/stats-dashboard && bunx vite --port 8002
scripts.build-stats: bun run build-stats-data && cd src/stats-dashboard && bunx vite build
scripts.stats: lsof -ti:8002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run dev-stats
scripts.scrape: (curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version > /dev/null 2>&1 || (echo '🌐 Starting Chrome with remote debugging...' && open -na 'Google Chrome' --args --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=$HOME/.chrome-debug-profile --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding --disable-background-timer-throttling && until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.5; done)) && bun run src/scraper/scrapeNotewriterClickThrough.ts
scripts.build-everything-web: cd src/everything-web && bunx vite build --mode prod-backend
scripts.build-ext-dev: cd src/everything-extension && VITE_CN_DEV_RELOAD=1 VITE_CN_BUILD=$(date +%H:%M:%S) bunx wxt build --mode prod-backend
scripts.build-ext: cd src/everything-extension && bunx wxt build --mode prod-backend && bunx wxt build -b firefox --mode prod-backend
scripts.zip-ext: cd src/everything-extension && bunx wxt zip --mode prod-backend && bunx wxt zip -b firefox --mode prod-backend
